Title: Runtime state-machine and transition-policy extraction
Purpose: Extract the runtime transition hotspot into smaller policy and planning services so runtime behavior becomes easier to test, review, and maintain without changing the public command surface.
Deliverables: A smaller public runtime command surface backed by extracted internal policy/planner services.
Separated logic for transition guard, branch validation, dependent activation, non-selected path resolution, and run-status recompute.
Tests that target the extracted runtime behaviors more directly.
ReviewQuestions: Did we truly decompose runtime transition responsibilities?
Are the extracted seams directly testable?
Did we avoid creating a differently named monolith?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If runtime logic is still effectively centralized or weakly proven, trigger the runtime/query corrective playbook before read-side work continues.
